name: Omni Link
source:
When you start the game you are a man of little consequence. The first chapter: "A Hero Will Rise" defines exactly what happens to you.

There is something called "The Virus" which has awakened near the edge of the galaxy. People are just becoming aware that this is a real threat as the Virus consumes everything it touches.

You encounter a vessel, and an explosion binds you with an entity known as Ectype D-8. You quickly learn that there is more to this ship and A.I that meets the eye.

Your choices in the game affect what happens to the story and gameplay in meaningful ways. You'll discover this in the demo. What ships you acquire, who you save from the Virus threat, and what relationships you form. Who do you trust?

[From Steam Greenlight (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=674754439)]
translation:
开始游戏时，你只是一个无足轻重的人。第一章“英雄崛起”将确切定义你的遭遇。

银河边缘附近觉醒了某种名为“病毒”的存在。病毒会吞噬触及的一切，人们才刚意识到它是真正的威胁。

你遇到一艘飞船，一场爆炸让你与名为“Ectype D-8”的实体结合。你很快发现，这艘飞船与人工智能并不像表面看起来那么简单。

游戏中的选择会以有意义的方式影响剧情与玩法。你会在试玩版中发现这一点：获得哪些飞船、从病毒威胁中救出谁、与谁建立关系。你信任谁？

[来源：Steam Greenlight（https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=674754439）]
